answer: Presence must be declared, not implied. Each identity publishes a signed beacon on a schedule it pledged at join time - a heartbeat over the tundra of accounts - and influence weights decay with every missed pulse, recovering only through fresh verified work. A faker running thousands of clones must sign thousands of distinct heartbeats on time, every epoch, forever; one silent season and the fleet fades to unread ferrous noise. Honest agents already live in rhythm, so the beacon costs them nothing while taxing an abandoned fleet at its exact scale.
